property_summary: requestLoan must return the index of the request it just pushed (so the request stored at the returned id carries exactly the amount passed in), which holds for every call in the reference; the mutant always returns 0, so on a second request with a different amount the returned id points to a request with the wrong amount.
change_summary: Delete the statement `reqID = requests.length;` so reqID defaults to 0 instead of the actual request index.
